source_note: 满足特定条件的两个集合尺寸的比例
english_source_note: Size Ratios of Two Sets Under Given Conditions
callout_id: 满足特定条件的两个集合尺寸的比例#1
statement_en: Let $A,B$ be two disjoint finite subsets of the integers, and let $a,b$ be two positive integers. Suppose moreover that $$A\cup B \subset (A-a)\cup (B+b)$$ where $A-a:=\{x-a:x \in A\}$ and $B+b:=\{x+b:x \in B\}$. Prove that $$a|A|=b|B|.$$
callout_body: $A,B$是整数集的两个不相交的有限子集，$a,b$是两个正整数，此外$$A\cup B \subset (A-a)\cup (B+b)$$其中$A-a:=\{x-a:x \in A\},B+b:=\{x+b:x \in B\}$证明$$a|A|=b|B|$$
